extracted.name: Eggs n' Fries
extracted.description: Grandma's secret recipe for breakfast eggs is out, and it's delicious! It's an egg scramble made with French fries.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup frozen French fries, or to taste
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add French fries; cook and stir until browned and hot, 3 to 5 minutes. Add eggs and season with salt and pepper; cook and stir until scrambled and set, 3 to 5 minutes.
